title: Brief special meeting before closed training session
subtitle: No policy items; council authorized an in-camera education and training session under the Municipal Act.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on October 21, 2024, chaired by Mayor Vrbanovic. It opened at 11:33 a.m. with a land acknowledgement. The City Clerk had given notice to all members under the council procedure chapter of the Municipal Code.

No one declared a pecuniary interest, and the Mayor had no business or updates to report. The only motion authorized a closed meeting right after the special meeting, so council could take part in an education and training session under the Municipal Act, 2001. Council approved it {{vote:m1}}. The meeting adjourned at 11:36 a.m.

For residents, this meeting made no decisions on policy, spending or services. Education and training sessions are a permitted reason to meet privately under the Act. The minutes report nothing further about what the session covered.

decisions.detail: Council authorized a closed meeting immediately after the special meeting to take part in an education and training session under Section 239 (3.1) of the Municipal Act, 2001 {{vote:m1}}.
